ranked.headline: LLM agents grounded in retrieval and benchmarks across drug discovery and biology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published framework test whether LLM agents can perform verifiable drug discovery, protein, and spatial biology analysis.

ranked.headline: Structured contacts and interaction rules reshape extinction and equilibrium outcomes
ranked.summary: Structured network topology, lockdown timing and game-theoretic contagion now receive analytic threshold and equilibrium treatment.

ranked.headline: Learned models and adaptive sampling target protein conformational states and stability
ranked.summary: Fine-tuned protein language models and adaptive MD sampling now reach metastable states and stability effects beyond single static structures.

ranked.headline: Spatial and single-cell omics representations address batch, modality and resolution…
ranked.summary: Spatial and single-cell multi-omics datasets now span heterogeneous samples, modalities and resolutions, demanding integration-aware representations.

ranked.headline: Simulations pinpoint residues and regions driving amyloid aggregation propensity
ranked.summary: Recent all-atom and enhanced-sampling MD studies localize aggregation-prone residues and regions in Aβ, Tau, α-synuclein and myocilin.

ranked.headline: Interactive and cloud tools open neuroimaging, morphology, and neuron model analysis
ranked.summary: Browser- and cloud-based open-source tools now bring atlas lookup, microCT morphology, and neuron model validation into web interfaces.

ranked.headline: Genome-resolved metagenomics expands known microbial biosynthetic and protein diversity
ranked.summary: Expanding genome and metagenome collections now expose uncharacterised biosynthetic clusters, protein families, and extremophile genomic signatures.

ranked.headline: GPT-style language models pretrained on protein, mRNA and DNA sequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints report large pretrained sequence models for protein fitness, mRNA design and genome-scale DNA prediction.

ranked.headline: Continuum and vertex models link confinement and forces to cell shape
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair cell-scale mechanical models with microfluidic, time-lapse, and single-cell measurements to test confinement and force effects.

ranked.headline: Memory-efficient k-mer alignment and modular pipelines scale genomic sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Genome assemblies now number in the hundreds of thousands, so analysis tools must search and annotate collections at million-genome scale.

ranked.headline: Selection and lifestyle shape bacterial and phage genomic diversity
ranked.summary: Four December 2025 preprints model selection, lifestyle, and phage-bacteria dynamics to interpret bacterial and phage genomic diversity.

ranked.headline: Attention and graph models add physics priors to interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair transformer and graph architectures with dynamics, physics priors, or substructure for interface and stability prediction.

ranked.headline: Accelerated ML and simulation methods for protein-ligand and peptide binding prediction
ranked.summary: Speed-accuracy trade-offs and explicit benchmarking against established methods now define new binding affinity, peptide, and design workflows.

ranked.headline: Physics-based and deep-learning models extend to RNA, DNA, and ssDNA targets
ranked.summary: Explicit polarization and AlphaFold 3 are now being tested on RNA, DNA, and ssDNA targets for binding-site and structure prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational models couple physical geometry with cell, tissue and embryo-scale dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published model apply simulation to cryopreservation, embryonic ciliary clearance and corneal injury recovery.

ranked.headline: Software automates preprocessing and validation of metabolomics and crosslinking MS data
ranked.summary: Omics outputs from diverse platforms and engines need interoperable, validated workflows, which these new tools address across R, Python, and Galaxy.

ranked.headline: Delay structure and noise govern timing precision and bistability in gene circuits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications treat delay timing and stochastic fluctuations as controlling parameters of gene circuit and network behavior.

ranked.headline: Machine learning ranks tumor neoantigens and immunogenic peptides from omics data
ranked.summary: Omics-driven and deep learning tools are now prioritizing tumor antigens and neoepitopes from transcriptomic and immunopeptidomic data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning and single-cell tools resolve cell-type-specific regulatory variation
ranked.summary: Deep learning now designs cell-type-specific enhancers, and single-cell and transposon analyses expose cell-state regulatory variation.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics methods integrate molecular layers across biomarker and single-cell tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and extend multi-omics integration for biomarker discovery, network inference, and single-cell programs.

ranked.headline: Calibrating nanopore direct RNA reads for accurate m6A and pseudouridine calling
ranked.summary: Direct nanopore RNA sequencing now demands explicit calibration of training and parameters to call modifications with high precision.

ranked.headline: Attention Models Predict Bacterial Resistance, Interactions and Protein Function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and one publication apply attention and hierarchical architectures to bacterial genomic and protein prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Individualized network models extend from brain parcellation to cerebral hemodynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair subject-specific network modeling with cross-cohort benchmarks, exposing generalization limits in MRI segmentation.

ranked.headline: Scalable software and estimators for heritability and fine-scale ancestry inference
ranked.summary: Recent items report faster or more accessible genetic analysis tools that retain accuracy relative to established methods.

ranked.headline: Sequencing-based primer and reference workflows for pathogen and food microbe detection
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark sequencing platforms and primer design tools for food and wastewater pathogen surveillance.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-scale assemblies connect haplotype diversity to disease and pest resistance
ranked.summary: Haplotype-resolved assemblies of polyploid and wild relative genomes now enable trait mapping at the level of specific gene copies.

ranked.headline: Computational models link tumour vasculature, drug transport and immune dynamics
ranked.summary: Patient-specific and agent-based tumour models now quantify how immunotherapy, antibody-drug conjugates and vasculature shape therapy response.

ranked.headline: Computational models recover hidden temporal structure from single-cell and imaging data
ranked.summary: Time-resolved single-cell and imaging datasets now demand computational inference of dynamics that assays do not directly report.

ranked.headline: Graph and physics-aware ML models predict protein-ligand binding affinity for screening
ranked.summary: Recent 2025 studies pair learned affinity scoring with public tools and multimodal graph architectures to prioritize candidate ligands.

ranked.headline: Software toolkits resolve clonal structure in single-cell DNA and integration-site data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints present software tools for single-cell DNA subclonality and lentiviral integration-site clonal dynamics in gene therapy safety.

ranked.headline: Computational design and scoring of protein binders and epitopes for binding specificity
ranked.summary: Computational binder design and epitope scoring are now paired with experimental checks, alongside automated benchmarking of macromolecular complexes.

ranked.headline: Simulated conformational ensembles calibrated against NMR and chemical probing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test whether force fields and coarse-grained models reproduce experimental NMR and chemical probing observables for proteins and RNA.

ranked.headline: Residue-level metrics test predicted structure reliability and domain-context effects
ranked.summary: Proteome-scale AlphaFold predictions now need quantitative reliability assessment, and neighboring domains alter local residue network features.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-resolved assembly of heterozygous genomes from long reads
ranked.summary: Recent work targets switch errors, reference bias, and reference-guided reassembly in long-read haplotype-resolved genome assembly.

ranked.headline: Calibrated mechanistic models link promoter kinetics and stress-response dynamics
ranked.summary: Calibrated, state-explicit models now tie regulatory and allosteric dynamics to measured dwell times and stress-response data.

ranked.headline: Pangenomes, acrocentric chromosome evolution, and miRNA gains and losses across mammals
ranked.summary: Near-complete genome assemblies and cross-species comparisons now resolve how structural variants, centromeres, and regulatory elements arise and persist.

ranked.headline: Pan-genomic and structural models map Bacillus subtilis secretome and levan biosynthesis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints pair LLM literature mining and pan-genomic deep learning with structure-annotated metabolic modeling of B. subtilis.

ranked.headline: Reference choice and haplotype-resolved assemblies shape alignment and variant analysis
ranked.summary: T2T-CHM13 lowers reference mapping bias at clinically relevant sites such as BRCA1, as new haplotype and pangenome assemblies widen reference options.
